semantics.blue: the function / the value / the base curve / self terms
semantics.red: the hook, the title, sensors and traces, sources, the key CTA line
semantics.purple: derived or shared quantities, the fusion beam, the lock, subtitles

type.engine: KaTeX 0.16.11, rendered at build time (output html, strict error), vendored fonts
type.rule: math italic only: never mathbf, mathrm, upright text; prose is textit in capitals; the single bold item is the title as textbf of textit
type.contrast: blue or purple text below 24 px needs 4.5:1 and fails; keep exponents and subscripts in blue or purple at 24 px or more, or colour only the base glyphs and leave exponents white

motion.eases: power1/2/3 only; back.out(2) on lit or popped terms; no elastic, no bounce
motion.transforms: animate x, y, scale, rotation; never left, top, width, height
motion.determinism: no Date.now, no unseeded random, no timers, no network at render time; seed with mulberry32
motion.history: scrolling traces are records: old points keep their shape, only new points change

watermark.brand: @MAE.Academy at about 12 percent opacity in red behind the graph, marked data-layout-ignore
watermark.forbidden: drifting platform badges (Instagram glyph plus handle in the corners)
watermark.ctaHandle: icon plus @MAE.ACADEMY inside the CTA card is allowed

sound.pad: open fifths A2 E3 A3 E4, third C# joins at the lock
sound.voice: A3 220 Hz additive partial sum, detune +/-0.5 Hz, low-pass 7.5 kHz
sound.pings: damped sine per harmonic that joins, amplitude 0.075 * k^-0.55
sound.export: -14 LUFS, true peak -1.5, peak of the generated wav below 0.98 (normalised to 0.85)
